description: Add transaction-internal claim/start/done primitives and an AgentWorkflow take/progress/release surface. Take must return an existing one claim or atomically select a new item, progress must require the current claim generation, idempotent replay must be a pure read, and ambiguous hosted commit outcomes must require read-only reconciliation rather than retry.

anti_patterns.dont: Call Git while BEGIN IMMEDIATE is held
Refresh a lease on exact replay without an event
anti_patterns.why: state changes outside the audit envelope

anti_patterns.dont: Reuse ready_items self-holder predicate for take
anti_patterns.instead: first return the existing claim, otherwise exclude self-held rows
anti_patterns.why: retries re-claim the same item and duplicate events

anti_patterns.instead: select and claim inside one caller-owned transaction
anti_patterns.why: another process can win between operations

preserves.behavior: BEGIN IMMEDIATE covers selection, claim update, and claim event as one transaction
Existing direct claim/start/done behavior changes only through explicit refactoring parity tests
Git subprocesses run before the write transaction and their snapshot is passed in
Mutating calls are never automatically retried after timeout or unknown commit outcome

verifications.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_agent_service.py tests/test_concurrency.py tests/test_hosted_backend.py

work_units.evidence: Internal locked claim and lifecycle primitives refactored in tracker.py

work_units.evidence: One-transaction atomic take with existing-claim adoption implemented
work_units.summary: Implement one-transaction take with distinct held-item predicates

work_units.evidence: Claim-token checked progress and read-only replay receipts implemented
work_units.summary: Implement claim-token checked start/done and pure replay receipts

work_units.evidence: Unknown commit reconciliation mapped through agent claims/context
work_units.summary: Map unknown commit outcomes to reconciliation through agent claims/context

work_units.evidence: Local process and adapter concurrency tests verified
work_units.summary: Run local process races and hosted-adapter-layer races with honest test names
